AGENTS.md

Source: AGENTS.md

This file gives guidance to coding agents working in this repository.

Project overview

shinylive is an R package that exports Shiny for R apps to static sites that run entirely in the browser through webR. It does three jobs:

  • Export (export()): copy the Shinylive web assets, the app files (as app.json), and WebAssembly (Wasm) binaries of the app’s R packages into a folder that any static web server can host.
  • Assets (assets_*()): download, cache, and manage versions of the Shinylive web assets from posit-dev/shinylive releases.
  • Quarto (quarto_ext()): a command-line interface called by the quarto-ext/shinylive extension. It prints JSON to stdout.

Much of the code was ported from posit-dev/py-shinylive, and the Quarto interface must match it. Commented-out Python in R/ is left over from that port.

Development commands

devtools::load_all()        # load the package
devtools::document()        # rebuild man/ and NAMESPACE from roxygen
devtools::test()            # run tests
devtools::test(filter = "export")
devtools::check()           # R CMD check

Format R code with air (air format .). CI checks the formatting.

Tests that need the assets

Most tests download the Shinylive assets (several hundred MB unpacked, cached after the first time) and are skipped unless the session is interactive or TEST_ASSETS is true. Run them from a shell with:

TEST_ASSETS=true Rscript -e 'devtools::test()'

The skip helper is skip_if_assets_unavailable() in tests/testthat/setup-skip.R. Tests that mock everything (for example, most of test-packages.R) run without the assets.

Code layout

See memory-bank/architecture.md for how the pieces fit and which file holds what.

Conventions

  • Quiet output: use the wrappers in R/cli.R (cli_alert_info(), cli_progress_step(), …) instead of calling cli:: directly for progress messages. Wrap a function body with local_quiet(quiet) to honor a quiet argument. Warnings and errors still use cli::cli_warn() and cli::cli_abort().
  • No user cache writes during CRAN tests: assets_cache_dir() stops when cran_is_testing() is true. Guard any new code that writes to a user cache the same way.
  • Environment variables change defaults: SHINYLIVE_ASSETS_VERSION, SHINYLIVE_WASM_PACKAGES, SHINYLIVE_DEFAULT_MAX_FILESIZE, and SHINYLIVE_DOWNLOAD_WASM_CORE_PACKAGES. Document new ones in the roxygen docs of the function they change.
  • NEWS: add a bullet to NEWS.md under the development version for any user-facing change.

Memory Bank

The memory-bank/ directory holds contributor documentation with YAML frontmatter (title, description). Before exploring the codebase, invoke the memory-bank skill to find and read the relevant docs. Start with memory-bank/architecture.md; it explains how the pieces fit and which doc covers each R/ file. Update or add docs when you learn something future contributors will need (see the skill for conventions).

Skills

Task-specific instructions live in .agents/skills/ (.claude/skills is a symlink to it):

  • memory-bank: find, read, and update the docs in memory-bank/.
  • update-assets-version: start a new assets series or raise the fallback version.
  • update-actions-tag: move the actions-v1 tag after changes to the reusable deploy-app workflow or examples/.

Only allowlisted skills are tracked, so when adding or removing one, update the !/.agents/skills/<name>/ lines in .gitignore to match.
